trust_decision.summary: Whether a config value is shown or replaced with '< hidden >' is decided by a literal (section, key) lookup in AirflowConfigParser.sensitive_config_values, which holds only base section names, so team-scoped spellings ([team=section] file sections, AIRFLOW__TEAM___SECTION__KEY env vars, team _cmd/_secret entries) are not recognised as sensitive.

landing_point.why: The summary names the 'Config API'; the single-option endpoint's literal sensitive_config_values check is the visible masking decision in the API layer.

fix_sites.module_kind: shared lower-level config parser library (separate shared/configuration distribution)
shared lower-level config parser library (write/render path)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: shared/configuration/src/airflow_shared/configuration/parser.py:2035-2038 (write(), reached by `airflow config list` at airflow-core/src/airflow/cli/commands/config_command.py:49-61) and parser.py:790-794 (_include_envs team env-var spelling)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names the Config API; `airflow config list` is a local admin CLI run by someone who already owns airflow.cfg, and the env-var path reports team values under an odd section name ('team_a', '_section__key') that looks like an unknown/ignored option rather than a sensitive one.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-sensitive team-scoped options (e.g. [team_a=core] parallelism) must stay readable through the API, display_sensitive=True callers must still get real values (kube_config and config lint call as_dict(display_sensitive=True)); masking every '='-section or every '___' env var breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: [<team>=<section>] config-file section holding a sensitive key
AIRFLOW__<TEAM>___<SECTION>__<KEY> environment variable (reported under section '<team>', key '_<section>__<key>')
team-scoped <key>_cmd and <key>_secret fallbacks, in file sections and as env vars (_CMD/_SECRET), which are not resolved for teams
team names containing '-', '_' or the '=' separator itself

O7_producer.where: shared/configuration/src/airflow_shared/configuration/parser.py:779-802 (_include_envs splits a team env var into section/key) and parser.py:1037-1040 (_env_var_name builds the TEAM___ spelling)

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different output channel (task/process logs, not config display); the advisory is about the Config API.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (airflow-core/src/airflow/configuration.py vs api_fastapi routes), subclass of the shared parser

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Task SDK mask_secrets: second implementation of the same base-only loop for worker-side log masking.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Separate distribution (task-sdk) and a log-masking concern rather than config exposure.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different distribution (task-sdk) from both landing point and fix sites

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Per-key secrets-backend kwarg masking matches literal 'secrets'/'workers' sections only, so a team-scoped AIRFLOW__<TEAM>___SECRETS__BACKEND_KWARG__* env var surfaced by as_dict under section '<team>' is not masked in GET /config.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The published fix itself documents it as not leaking because the secrets backend is not team aware (fix.diff:59-63).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same airflow-core API package as landing point (services module), sink in shared parser _include_envs

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A team filter on GET /config (or a team-scoped single-option lookup via conf.get(..., team_name=)) that masks with the base (section, key) tuple only.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Multi-team config is new and conf.get already takes team_name (parser.py:1121-1124 hunk in fix.diff:270-272); a maintainer adding team views would reuse the existing literal lookup.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: _filter_by_source / include_* =False branch made team-aware for sources but keyed on base sensitive tuples.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already iterates sensitive_config_values by base name, the same idiom the fix had to replace in as_dict.
